exercise.prompt:
Your portfolio has commits but has never been online. An empty repository waits at `https://github.com/you/portfolio.git`.
1. Add it as a remote called `origin`.
2. Push `main` and set its upstream.
3. Create `about.md` with `echo "# About me" > about.md`, commit it with the message `Add about page`, and push again.
exercise.promptHi:
Aapke portfolio mein commits hain par woh kabhi online nahi gaya. `https://github.com/you/portfolio.git` par ek khaali repository intezaar kar rahi hai.
1. Use `origin` naam ke remote ki tarah jodo.
2. `main` ko push karo aur uska upstream set karo.
3. `echo "# About me" > about.md` se `about.md` banao, use message `Add about page` ke saath commit karo, aur dobara push karo.

checks.label: A commit says `Add about page`
checks.labelHi: Ek commit `Add about page` kehta hai

checks.label: GitHub has all your commits
checks.labelHi: GitHub par aapke saare commits hain
